rationale: Usage-report summary endpoint returned aggregate counts to anonymous callers; fix adds an authenticated-user check in the handler.
Kubernetes NetworkPolicy deployment flaw in infrastructure code; not an HTTP operation access decision.
AdminAuth middleware let requests proceed when admin lookup returned no user, so a non-admin token holder could reach admin-only routes. Affected operation not named in material.
Authenticated user could duplicate a readable project under any parent project without write access to that parent; PUT duplicate route not visible in truncated contract.

Users lacking Execute Code permission could configure a controller service enabling script execution, since the component lacked the Restricted annotation; contract is a stub without the operation.
Chain transactions let one account spend funds from another's address via DID verification methods, as payer was not checked against signer. Blockchain tx interface only loosely an HTTP service.
Header-name constants in an integration library; no HTTP operation of a service involved.
GET attachment by UUID returned files of private repositories to anonymous or unauthorised users; fix adds repository access check.

Generated pg_hba.conf trust entries for local database access; not reachable through the service's HTTP API.
Network policy parsing in a CNI datapath; traffic filtering, not an HTTP operation access decision.

Network policy egress derivation in a CNI; not an HTTP operation access decision.
